schools.description: Institution-level College Scorecard records: filter on any field (school.state=CA, school.ownership=1, <field>__range=lo..hi), choose columns with fields=, sort=<field>:asc|desc.

fields.desc: comma-separated field names or catalog aliases (default: the popular set); without it every school has about 3,000 fields

id.desc: UNITID (IPEDS id), e.g. 166683; comma-separated for several

school.name.desc: name search (partial words match), e.g. 'University of Delaware'

school.state.desc: two-letter state code; comma-separated for several (DE,MD)

school.degrees_awarded.predominant.desc: 0 not classified, 1 certificate, 2 associate, 3 bachelor's, 4 graduate

ownership.name: Control
ownership.description: ownership control: 1 public, 2 private nonprofit, 3 private for-profit

predominant_degree.name: Predominant degree
predominant_degree.description: predominant degree awarded: 0-4 (certificate, associate, bachelor's, graduate)

sat_avg.name: SAT average
sat_avg.description: average SAT equivalent score of admitted students

size.name: Undergraduate enrollment
size.description: number of degree-seeking undergraduate students (enrollment size)

tuition_in_state.name: In-state tuition and fees
tuition_in_state.description: in-state tuition and fees, dollars per year (cost)

tuition_out_of_state.name: Out-of-state tuition and fees
tuition_out_of_state.description: out-of-state tuition and fees, dollars per year (cost)

net_price.name: Average net price
net_price.description: average annual net price after grant aid, Title IV students (cost)

attendance_cost.name: Cost of attendance
attendance_cost.description: average cost of attendance, academic-year institutions (cost)

median_debt.name: Median debt of completers
median_debt.description: median federal loan debt of students who completed (student debt, loans)

pell_rate.name: Pell grant rate
pell_rate.description: share of undergraduates receiving Pell grants (low income)

loan_rate.name: Federal loan rate
loan_rate.description: share of undergraduates with federal loans

completion_rate.name: Completion rate
completion_rate.description: completion (graduation) rate within 150% of normal time, share 0-1, small cohorts suppressed

retention_rate.name: Retention rate
retention_rate.description: first-time full-time retention rate, four-year institutions

earnings_10yr.name: Median earnings 10 years after entry
earnings_10yr.description: median earnings of federally aided students working, 10 years after entry (salary, income)

earnings_6yr.name: Median earnings 6 years after entry
earnings_6yr.description: median earnings 6 years after entry (salary, income)

earnings_7yr.name: Median earnings 7 years after entry
earnings_7yr.description: median earnings 7 years after entry (salary, income); live in the API from October 2026

default_rate_3yr.name: 3-year cohort default rate
default_rate_3yr.description: official three-year cohort default rate (loan default); near zero for recent cohorts because federal loan repayment was paused 2020-2023

share_white.name: Share White
share_white.description: share of undergraduates who are White (race ethnicity demographics)

share_black.name: Share Black
share_black.description: share of undergraduates who are Black (race ethnicity demographics)

share_hispanic.name: Share Hispanic
share_hispanic.description: share of undergraduates who are Hispanic (race ethnicity demographics)

share_first_generation.name: First-generation share
share_first_generation.description: share of students who are first-generation college students

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: urban-centric locale code (city, suburb, town, rural)

hbcu.name: HBCU flag
hbcu.description: historically Black college or university (minority serving)

programs_cip4.name: Field-of-study records
programs_cip4.description: field of study (program, major) records with earnings and debt by credential; very large: request one school at a time
